removed.reason: inspectsTheVersionsBundledWithAPluginDirectory needs an isolated URLClassLoader to find a plugin's own META-INF/io.netty.versions.properties, but Native Image's ClassLoader.getResources substitution returns the embedded image resource to every class loader whenever one exists (GR-19998), so Version.identify(pluginLoader) sees only netty-common; no metadata entry or native-image option changes that loader semantics, and the resource must stay registered for the classpath scenarios.
